response.sql: SELECT rental_totals.store_id, AVG(rental_totals.total_amount) AS avg_total_per_rental, AVG(rental_totals.payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental FROM (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(p.payment_id) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id) rental_totals GROUP BY rental_totals.store_id;
